author: Polar_Express
body:
Quick Questions...
Would anyone know if the number of teams on the walls can be changed? I am developing a map and need to know if I can have less than 4. I an certain the Avicore Plugin can do it ( it does for other game modes), but just need to know...
The map I am developing is a real game changer and I think it will have the walls community excited, its nothing like what we currently play and feel it could be a map that takes Avicus to a new gameplay level - atleast for walls folks.
Funky (IVY) if you are around can you meet me in game? Got a question. - also what's up with my Rank... I was emerald.. now I am gold...

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: Well more than  4 teams kind of  makes the "team" part of walls not happen.... but less teams would make bigger teams... we need bigger teams as some times we log in and we end up with 4 teams of two, then the walls drop and we people have logged out... so you get a team of 1  fighting a team of 2-3... or one team mate dies and you got the same situation...
